It also includes H.R. 6774, which would finally create a pilot  program at the Federal Housing Administration to offer small-dollar  mortgages.

It includes my bill, H.R. 6773, which directs cities across America  to finally publish a database of their unused land so that developers  may be able to bid on it…

There is much more that we can do, from supporting tax credits for  first-time home buyers to expanding access to small-dollar mortgages.  There are also things we should undo, like reversing Trump's tariffs on  building materials and reinstating inclusionary borrowing programs that  have been canceled…
